name: Sector Utilities
description: Provides utilities, UX, and UI improvements for Sector.

suggests.drupal/entity_usage: Adds media-usage helper text on the media delete form.
suggests.drupal/ds: Enables the unpublished view-mode CSS-class hook (hook_ds_pre_render_alter).

project_description: Submodule of Sector Legacy. Provides editor-experience and admin UI improvements for the Sector distribution: node/media form tweaks under Claro, nicer file-size and MIME-type field output, an unpublished-content view-mode class, optional entity_usage helper text on the media delete form, and a permission to gate the contextual 'Configure block' link.
